headline_stat.name: fraction of MEC units significantly exceeding per-unit shuffle 95th-pct gridness null
headline_stat.value: 'a substantial fraction' — no value computed; population run incomplete, no CSV produced

justification.dataset: 000582 is the canonical Sargolini MEC grid-cell dataset with the standard species, region, and open-field paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct pynapple tuning-curve and occupancy handling, but no unit quality filtering and inclusion criteria are unjustified.
justification.analysis: The rotational gridness score and circular-shift shuffle null are correctly designed and standard, though the significance control was never actually run to completion.
justification.correctness: The prototype gridness values reproduce and are internally consistent with the figure, but the headline significance/'substantial fraction' claim traces to no committed output because the population run and its CSV never completed.
justification.figures: The one existing prototype figure clearly shows hexagonal autocorrelograms so the effect is visible, but axes are unlabeled and the README's referenced population figures do not exist.
justification.honesty: The write-up presents a completed shuffle-significance population analysis and cites a CSV, notebook, and figures that do not exist, asserting a statistical finding with no committed output and no stated limitation.
